reason: The cited evidence (E2, E3) discusses thermodynamic modeling of Ta-Cr/V systems and entropy contributions in CoCrFeNiTax, neither of which provides any data on thermal expansion mismatch, residual stresses, or dislocation pinning in HfNbTaTiZr. The key premises are entirely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Nanoscale thermal expansion mismatch exists between distorted/precipitate regions and the matrix in HfNbTaTiZr.
This mismatch generates internal residual stresses that pin dislocations.
Dislocation pinning by these stresses counteracts thermal softening, causing a strength plateau.
Reducing the mismatch will eliminate the plateau and restore conventional softening.
